title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Current-Term Credit Basis for Overlap Credits
content:
**Current-term credit basis (Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, overlap schedule).** For the overlap credit on a certificate ending on confirmed borrower coverage, the part of the credit drawn from the certificate's current term — the term on its latest renewal entry, or on its issue entry when it has no renewal entry — is set by where the borrower's coverage start (the effective date on the borrower evidence) falls:

| Borrower's coverage start | Current-term overlap credit |
|---|---|
| On or before the current term's start date | The whole premium of the current term |
| After the start date and before the expiration date | The current term's premium multiplied by the days from the borrower's coverage start to the current term's expiration date, divided by the days from the current term's start date to its expiration date, rounded half to even to the cent |
| On or after the current term's expiration date | Zero |

Days between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the later date, the earlier date excluded and the later date included.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical term 1 July to 1 July of the next year, premium 900.00 dollars).**
- Coverage start 1 July, the term's start date: the whole 900.00 dollars.
- Coverage start 15 June, before the term began: the whole 900.00 dollars.
- Coverage start 1 July of the next year, the expiration date: zero.
- Coverage start 2 July: 364 of the term's 365 days remain, so 900.00 multiplied by 364 and divided by 365, that is 897.53 dollars.
